question: For The Estee Lauder Companies (fiscal year ends June 30), report GAAP gross margin (gross profit / net sales, in %) and GAAP operating margin (operating income (loss) / net sales, in %) for each of its last four reported fiscal quarters as of October 3, 2026. Label each quarter with its fiscal quarter, fiscal year and period-end date. Use GAAP figures as reported (not adjusted/non-GAAP); fourth-quarter results are not separately filed on a 10-Q.
grading: Graded cell by cell: each value within tolerance and for the stated period; a missing cell counts as wrong.
answer:
Estee Lauder GAAP margins (Q4 FY2026 derived as FY2026 minus nine months and matching the Q4 release):
| Row | Gross margin | Operating margin |
|---|---|---|
| Q1 FY2026 (ended 2025-09-30) | 73.37% | 4.85% |
| Q2 FY2026 (ended 2025-12-31) | 76.50% | 9.48% |
| Q3 FY2026 (ended 2026-03-31) | 76.40% | 6.71% |
| Q4 FY2026 (ended 2026-06-30) | 75.46% | -1.08% |

output.answer:
## The Estée Lauder Companies — GAAP Margins, Last Four Reported Fiscal Quarters (as of Oct. 3, 2026)

All four quarters are from **fiscal 2026** (FY ends June 30). Figures are as-reported (GAAP), per the company's earnings releases/10-Qs.

| Quarter | Period-End | Net Sales | Gross Profit | GAAP Gross Margin | Operating Income (Loss) | GAAP Operating Margin |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Q1 FY2026 | Sep 30, 2025 | $3,481M | $2,554M | **73.4%** | $169M | **4.9%** |
| Q2 FY2026 | Dec 31, 2025 | $4,229M | $3,235M | **76.5%** | $401M | **9.5%** |
| Q3 FY2026 | Mar 31, 2026 | $3,712M | $2,836M | **76.4%** | $249M | **6.7%** |
| Q4 FY2026 | Jun 30, 2026 | $3,627M | $2,737M | **75.5%** | $(39)M | **(1.1)%** |

**Notes**
- Gross margin = gross profit ÷ net sales; operating margin = operating income (loss) ÷ net sales. Ratios are computed from the reported dollar figures (the company's stated margins round to the same values).
- Q4 FY2026 is not separately 10-Q'd; figures come from the full-year earnings release (10-K basis). Q4 GAAP operating income was a **loss of $39M**, driven largely by $306M of restructuring/other charges under the Profit Recovery and Growth Plan — hence the negative GAAP margin versus a positive adjusted margin.
- Q3 FY2026 GAAP operating income of $249M included $224M of restructuring charges and an $84M securities class-action settlement, so the GAAP operating margin (6.7%) sits well below the ~15% adjusted figure.
